decisions.reason: The quote directly states 'the disease manifests as vision loss in early childhood,' clearly establishing that CLN3 Batten disease has the phenotype of vision loss. The subject of the sentence is 'the disease' and the object is 'vision loss.'

The quote directly states the disease 'progresses to neurological dysfunction,' clearly establishing that CLN3 Batten disease has the phenotype of neurological dysfunction. The subject of the sentence is 'the disease' and the object is 'neurological dysfunction.'

The quote directly states 'a splice-switching antisense oligonucleotide (ASO)...can reduce neurological disease burden in mouse models of CLN3 disease,' demonstrating that the ASO molecule produces a therapeutic effect on CLN3 disease. The mechanism and evidence are directly stated.

The quote states 'The ASO treatment resulted in higher amplitudes on electroretinograms, suggesting mitigation of retinal dysfunction at early timepoints of disease.' The quote uses the word 'mitigation,' which is explicitly inferring a therapeutic effect on retinal dysfunction. The connection between increased electroretinogram amplitudes and reduction of retinal dysfunction is stated directly in the abstract.
